messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered - elevated 5xx and streaming disconnects observed across streaming-gateway in eu-west-1 and us-east-1. Initial spike at 2026-03-15T14:20Z. Paging SRE oncall.
sre-oncall: I'm on it. confirming scope: is this only streaming endpoints or also paged endpoints?
alex w: streaming only so far. metrics: streaming-gateway 5xx rate ~8% (baseline <0.3%), client disconnects spike, RPS normal but connection churn high. top error is `RST_STREAM` followed by `chunked: unexpected EOF`.

maria g: seeing same in tracing - a lot of partial chunk flushover on Fanout route. looks correlated with a gateway config change rolled 2h ago (keepalive=20s -> 10s) from the networking team.
devon k: fyi that config rollout included an optimization for worker recycling. suspecting aggressive keepalive + fanout leads to upstream resets under burst.
sre-oncall: can we confirm logs? alex can you paste recent gateway logs around a sample failed request?
alex w: pasted sample logs below:
```
2026-03-15T14:22:41Z streaming-gateway[worker-12]: conn_id=abc123 client=10.32.4.12 route=/v1/stream fanout=6 err=RST_STREAM code=2 proto=HTTP/2
2026-03-15T14:22:41Z backend-proxy[up-3]: upstream=34.56.78.90 session=xyz456 error=chunked: unexpected EOF bytes_sent=345
2026-03-15T14:22:42Z streaming-gateway[worker-12]: conn_id=abc124 client=10.32.4.13 err=client_cancelled
```
sre-oncall: that `fanout=6` is concerning. we should reduce fanout and enable fallback to paged responses for high-fanout routes as a live mitigation. can someone make a quick routing override?
riley: I can push a routing override to throttle fanout to 2 for `route=/v1/stream/*` in eu-west-1 and us-east-1. will also add header `X-Response-Fallback: paged` for requests that are long-polling. executing now.

riley: Command I ran (internal admin API):
```
curl -s -X POST "https://admin.internal/config/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"scope":"eu-west-1,us-east-1","route":"/v1/stream/*","fanout_limit":2,"inject_header":{"X-Response-Fallback":"paged"}}'
```
alex w: override deployed in eu-west-1 and us-east-1. immediate drop in connection churn observed on dashboards, 5xx down to ~3.2% in last 3 mins. some clients still seeing partial transcripts.
maria g: enabling fallback will cause some clients to switch to paged behavior — visible as increased latency for long responses but avoids hard disconnects. we should message support & success.
sre-oncall: can we also revert the keepalive change? if the config rollout earlier reduced keepalive to 10s, let's restore to 60s as interim. devon, can you patch that?
devon k: rolling keepalive back to 60s on gateway pool now. command:
```
kubectl -n gateway set env deployment/gateway --env KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT=60
```
devon k: applied in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. pods are rolling, new pods report KEEPALIVE=60.

sre-oncall: good. monitor for any regression. alex, can we quantify customer impact? which tenants saw errors?
alex w: customer-scope: 12 tenants had >5% error rate during window. largest impacted customer is Acme Chat - about 6% of their streaming sessions had partial transcript loss between 14:20-15:05 UTC. We flagged them to support.
pagerduty: Acme Chat - CUST-472: high severity degraded streaming (partial transcript loss). Incident routed to account team.
maria g: mitigation status: fanout limit and fallback header in place, keepalive restored. streaming 5xx dropped to 1.0% after rollback + override, disconnects down 85%. but tail latency for fallback sessions increased ~400ms.
sre-oncall: yay. immediate live mitigation done. next: root cause RCA — likely combination of keepalive reduction + worker recycling causing upstream pools to close connections mid-chunk under high parallel fanout. assign devon + networking to investigate.
devon k: assigning to myself and neteng. will capture heap/cpu traces and gateway connection stats. scheduling deep-dive now.

maria g: action items for PMF/CS: notify top 20 tenants with summary, update status page with degraded streaming note and list mitigations. I'll draft the message.
sre-oncall: customer impact summary for postmortem: approx 12 tenants affected, window 14:20-15:05 UTC, highest 6% session loss for Acme Chat, mitigations reduced 5xx from 8% -> 1.0%.

alex w: quick note — observed a small config drift: some gateways still running older binary that ignores fallback header. patching that in background.

sre-oncall: good catch. keep me posted. anyone see any bursts still?
riley: small blip in ap-southeast-1 after changes propagated (~14:58Z) but resolved when we sync the override.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Live mitigation applied — fanout limit and fallback routing in eu-west-1/us-east-1; gateway keepalive reverted. Incident flagged for full postmortem. Assigning P0 -> SRE team.
sre-oncall: summary for on-call handoff: mitigations in place, customer impact assessed, follow-ups: devon (root cause & code fix), maria (status page + tenant comms), alex (verify older gateways patched), neteng (review deployment gating for config rollouts). I'll own the postmortem coordination.
maria g: noted. I'll coordinate tenant messaging and schedule a postmortem meeting for tomorrow. :thumbsup:

devon k: will follow up with logs and repro. tentatively suspect worker recycling + lowered keepalive causing abrupt upstream closes under high concurrent fanout.
sre-oncall: closing pager for now. if any regression, re-open. thanks all. :pray:
